notes.title: The Sequel to Aselia is Now On Steam!
notes.notes:
The next game in the Eternity Sword series, Seinarukana, is now on Steam!

It's the sequel to Aselia the Eternal, and further develops the Eternity Sword setting with a new cast of interesting characters, as well as a few familiar faces. It also features improved graphics and gameplay, with all the strategic and tactical challenge that made Aselia great.

There is a special discount for owners of Aselia, and for this week only it's an even better deal with the Seinarukana launch discount (up to 28% off). If you enjoyed Aselia, now's a great chance to pick up the next game in the series. We hope you enjoy it!
